raw.content_en: The US Department of Commerce (BIS) has streamlined export controls for sound suppressors (silencers), moving certain models from stricter controls to more permissive licensing treatment under the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). While this reduces licensing friction for eligible items, exporters must still classify the correct ECCN, confirm the destination and end-user are not restricted, and align US HTS codes with Section 301 tariff exposure. Firearm parts and accessories remain sensitive; shipments to embargoed or sanctioned destinations, or to parties on the Entity List / Denied Persons List, are prohibited. Retain classification, license exception, and end-use/end-user documentation for at least five years.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部（BIS）已简化对消音器（抑制器）的出口管制，将部分型号从较严格管制调整为《出口管理条例》（EAR）下更宽松的许可待遇。虽然合规出口的许可摩擦降低，但出口商仍须正确归类ECCN、确认目的地和最终用户不受限制，并使美国HTS编码与301条款关税风险对齐。枪械零部件和附件仍属敏感物项；对禁运或受制裁目的地、或列入实体清单/被拒绝人员名单的当事方出口均被禁止。归类、许可例外及最终用途/最终用户文件须至少保存五年。

checklist.desc: Determine the correct ECCN (e.g., 0A501 / 0A502 family) for the specific sound suppressor and confirm whether the streamlined treatment applies; document technical specs and rationale.
Screen the buyer, consignee, and end-user against the BIS Entity List, Denied Persons List, and SDN list; retain screening evidence and end-use/end-user statements.
Map the 10-digit HTS line (e.g., 9305.91) against Section 301 lists and additional duties; document country of origin, value build-up, and any exclusion.
If shipping under a license exception or streamlined authorization, prepare the supporting statement, destination control statement, and AES/EEI filing where required.
Verify the importing country's firearms/parts import permit and any ATF or local law enforcement requirements; confirm no embargoed destination is involved.

raw.content_en: The US Department of Commerce (BIS) rescinded the Biden-era firearms rule, restoring prior export control treatment for civilian firearms and ammunition. This reduces licensing burdens for certain semi-automatic firearms and related parts under the EAR, but does not eliminate all controls: items may still fall under USML Category I (ITAR) or EAR 0x5zz / 0A501 catch-all controls, and end-user/end-use restrictions, embargoed destinations, and Entity List screening remain mandatory. Exporters must re-verify ECCN classification, license exceptions, and destination-based prohibitions before shipment.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的枪支出口规则，恢复对民用枪支弹药的原有出口管制待遇。此举降低了部分半自动枪支及相关零部件的许可负担，但并未取消全部管制：相关物项仍可能落入USML第一类（ITAR）或EAR 0x5zz / 0A501兜底管制，且最终用户/最终用途限制、禁运目的地及实体清单筛查仍为强制要求。出口商在发运前必须重新核实ECCN分类、许可例外及基于目的地的禁令。

checklist.desc: Re-confirm whether each firearm, part, or accessory is controlled under USML Category I (ITAR) or EAR ECCN 0A501/0x5zz; document the classification rationale and retain for 5 years.
Assess whether the rescinded rule restores eligibility for License Exception RPL, TMP, or GOV for the specific destination; verify no new BIS general prohibition applies.
Screen all consignees, intermediate consignees, and end users against BIS Entity List, Denied Persons List, and OFAC SDN; retain screening evidence.
Obtain a signed non-transferable end-user certificate stating civilian use and no re-export to embargoed destinations (Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria, Russia/Belarus as applicable).

checklist.task: AES / EEI filing and HTS alignment
checklist.desc: File Electronic Export Information in AES for shipments requiring a license or valued over USD 2,500; align Schedule B / HTS 9302.00, 9303.30, 9305.20 with the commercial invoice.
Confirm the importing country's firearms import license, proof of end use, and any transit-country authorization before booking freight.

raw.content_en: The US Department of Commerce (BIS) rescinded the Biden-era firearms rule, restoring prior export control treatment for civilian firearms, ammunition, and parts. For China exporters of firearms-related components, optics, and accessories, this shifts licensing thresholds and classification practice for US-bound shipments. Exporters must still align 10-digit HTS lines, screen against the Entity List and restricted parties, and confirm whether items fall under USML (ITAR) versus CCL (EAR) jurisdiction. Section 301 tariff exposure on China-origin goods remains separate from export control status. Retain end-use/end-user statements and origin documentation to support US customs and BIS review.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的枪支规则，恢复了对民用枪支、弹药及零部件的原有出口管制待遇。对于向美国出口枪械相关零部件、光学器件及配件的中国出口商而言，许可门槛与归类实践将发生变化。出口商仍须对齐10位HTS编码，筛查实体清单及受限方，并确认物项属于USML（ITAR）还是CCL（EAR）管辖。中国原产货物的301关税风险与出口管制状态相互独立。应保留最终用途/最终用户声明及原产地文件，以应对美国海关与BIS审查。

checklist.desc: Determine whether each firearm part, optic, or accessory falls under USML (ITAR) or CCL (EAR); document classification rationale and any license exceptions.
Screen all US consignees, brokers, and end users against the BIS Entity List, SDN list, and denied persons lists; retain screening records.
Map 10-digit HTS lines for firearms parts and optics; verify Section 301 list coverage and additional duty rates; document country of origin.
Obtain and retain signed non-transferable end-use and end-user statements from US buyers for controlled firearm components.
For electronic sights, rangefinders, or RF accessories, confirm FCC Part 15/18 conformity and supplier FCC IDs before US entry.
Ensure invoices state full description, HTS code, origin, and value build-up; avoid vague terms like 'gun parts' that trigger CBP holds.

raw.content_en: The US Department of Commerce (BIS) rescinded the Biden-era firearms rule, restoring prior export control treatment for civilian firearms, ammunition, and parts. For China exporters of firearms, ammunition, optics, and related components to the US market, this reduces some licensing friction but does not eliminate core obligations: items remain subject to the US export control regime, and US importers must still satisfy ATF, FCC (for electronic sights/optics with RF modules), and Section 301 tariff requirements. Exporters should re-verify HS classification under Chapter 93, confirm whether items fall under the rescinded rule's scope, and screen all parties against BIS Entity List, OFAC SDN, and denied party lists. Section 301 tariffs on Chinese-origin goods remain a major cost factor, and US HTS alignment at the 10-digit level is essential for customs clearance. Retain end-use/end-user documentation and monitor any future rulemaking that could re-impose controls.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的枪支出口规则，恢复了对民用枪支、弹药及零部件的原有出口管制待遇。对于向美国市场出口枪支、弹药、光学瞄具及相关部件的中国出口商而言，这减少了一定的许可摩擦，但并未消除核心义务：相关物项仍受美国出口管制体系约束，美国进口商仍须满足ATF、FCC（针对带射频模块的电子瞄具/光学设备）以及301条款关税要求。出口商应重新核实第93章HS归类，确认物项是否属于被撤销规则的适用范围，并对所有交易方进行BIS实体清单、OFAC SDN及被拒绝方名单筛查。针对中国原产商品的301条款关税仍是主要成本因素，按10位美国HTS编码对齐对清关至关重要。应保留最终用途/最终用户文件，并关注未来可能重新施加管制的规则制定动态。

checklist.desc: Re-confirm 10-digit US HTS codes for firearms, ammunition, and parts (9302/9303/9305) and verify whether items fall within the rescinded rule's scope.
For electronic sights, rangefinders, or RF-enabled accessories, confirm FCC ID, modular approval, and Part 15/18 conformity before US entry.
Map each HTS line against Section 301 lists, calculate additional duty exposure, and document country of origin and value build-up.

checklist.task: BIS / Entity List / OFAC screening pack
checklist.desc: Run restricted party and denied party screening; retain end-user and end-use statements and export control classification records.
Coordinate with the US importer on ATF Form 6/6A requirements and any state-level firearms restrictions that may affect delivery.
Prepare invoices, packing lists, and origin declarations consistent with US CBP requirements; flag any transshipment risk.

raw.content_en: The US Department of Commerce (BIS) has rescinded the Biden-era firearms rule, restoring prior export control treatment for civilian firearms, ammunition, and parts. This reduces licensing burdens for certain semi-automatic firearms and related components previously moved to stricter controls. Exporters must still comply with the Arms Export Control Act (ITAR) where applicable, the Export Administration Regulations (EAR), and the US Munitions List (USML) boundary. Key actions: re-classify affected products under the correct ECCN or USML category, verify end-user/end-use, screen against the Entity List and denied party lists, and align commercial invoices with 10-digit HTS codes. Section 301 tariffs and FCC Part 15/18 requirements remain relevant for electronics-enabled firearms accessories. Note that state-level and international import restrictions (e.g., EU, ASEAN) may still apply.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的枪支出口规则，恢复了对民用枪支、弹药及零部件的原有出口管制待遇。此举降低了此前被收紧管制的部分半自动枪支及相关部件的许可负担。出口商仍须遵守《武器出口管制法》（ITAR，如适用）、《出口管理条例》（EAR）以及美国军品清单（USML）的边界。关键行动：对受影响产品按正确的ECCN或USML类别重新分类，核实最终用户和最终用途，对照实体清单和被拒绝方名单进行筛查，并确保商业发票与10位HTS编码一致。对于带电子功能的枪支配件，Section 301关税及FCC Part 15/18要求仍然适用。注意州级及国际进口限制（如欧盟、东盟）可能依然存在。

checklist.desc: 根据撤销后的规则，确认民用枪支、弹药及零部件应归入的ECCN或USML类别，更新内部合规矩阵。

checklist.task: 最终用户/最终用途核实
checklist.desc: 收集并保存最终用户声明和最终用途说明，确保不涉及受制裁方或军事最终用途。

checklist.task: 实体清单与拒绝方筛查
checklist.desc: 对交易各方进行BIS实体清单、被拒绝方名单及OFAC制裁名单筛查，保留筛查记录。
将产品映射至10位HTS编码，核查Section 301附加关税及原产地规则，准确申报货值。
对含无线或电子功能的枪支配件，确认FCC ID及模块认证，确保符合美国射频设备要求。

checklist.task: 出口许可证申请（如需要）
checklist.desc: 若产品仍受EAR或ITAR管制，向BIS或DDTC提交许可证申请，并保留批准文件。

raw.content_en: The US Department of Commerce (BIS) has rescinded the Biden-era firearms rule, restoring prior export control treatment for civilian firearms, ammunition, and parts. This reduces licensing burdens for certain semi-automatic firearms and related components previously moved to stricter controls. Exporters must still classify goods under the correct USML or CCL category, verify EAR99 versus controlled status, and screen all parties against BIS Entity List, Denied Persons List, and OFAC sanctions. Section 301 tariffs and HTS alignment remain relevant for commercial shipments, and FCC Part 15/18 conformity applies to any wireless or electronic accessories. Retain end-use and end-user documentation, especially for destinations subject to enhanced scrutiny.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的枪支出口规则，恢复对民用枪支、弹药及零部件的原有出口管制待遇。此前被收紧管制的部分半自动枪支及相关部件，其许可负担有所降低。出口商仍须按正确的USML或CCL类别进行归类，核实EAR99与受控状态，并对所有交易方进行BIS实体清单、被拒绝人员名单及OFAC制裁筛查。商业发货仍需关注301关税与HTS归类一致性，涉及无线或电子配件的还需符合FCC Part 15/18要求。应保留最终用途和最终用户文件，尤其是对受强化审查的目的地。

checklist.desc: Re-classify firearms, ammunition, and parts under the revised rule; confirm USML Category I/II versus CCL ECCN status and document the basis for EAR99 or license exception eligibility.
For electronic sights, wireless accessories, or RF modules, verify FCC ID, modular approvals, and Part 15/18 compliance before US export or re-export.
Screen all consignees, end users, and intermediaries against BIS Entity List, Denied Persons List, Unverified List, and OFAC SDN; retain screening records and end-user statements.
Map the 10-digit HTS line against Section 301 lists and additional duties; document country of origin, value build-up, and any exclusion or refund eligibility.
Confirm whether a license exception (e.g., RPL, TMP, GOV) applies and verify destination-country restrictions; prepare DSP-5/DSP-73 or EAR license applications where required.
For electronic components and accessories, confirm RoHS/REACH compliance and WEEE producer responsibility registration for EU-bound or re-exported goods.

raw.content_en: The US Department of Commerce (BIS) rescinded the Biden-era firearms rule, restoring prior export control treatment for civilian firearms, ammunition, and parts. For China-origin exporters and re-exporters, this changes license requirements and classification for sporting and hunting firearms under ECCNs and USML Category I boundaries. Verify whether items fall under EAR99, ECCN 0A501/0A502/0A504, or ITAR USML Category I, and confirm the new license exception eligibility. Screen all parties against the BIS Entity List, Denied Persons List, and OFAC SDN. Align commercial invoices with 10-digit HTS codes and retain end-use/end-user statements. Note that Section 301 tariffs and FCC Part 15/18 requirements still apply to wireless-enabled accessories.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的枪支出口规则，恢复了对民用枪支、弹药及零部件的原有出口管制待遇。对于中国原产出口商和再出口商而言，这改变了运动及狩猎枪支在ECCN和美国军品清单（USML）第一类边界下的许可要求和分类。需核实物品属于EAR99、ECCN 0A501/0A502/0A504还是ITAR USML第一类，并确认新的许可例外适用性。对所有交易方进行BIS实体清单、被拒绝人员名单及OFAC SDN筛查。商业发票需与10位HTS编码对齐，并保留最终用途/最终用户声明。注意：第301节关税及FCC Part 15/18要求仍适用于带无线的配件。

checklist.desc: Determine whether firearms, ammunition, and parts fall under EAR99, ECCN 0A501/0A502/0A504, or ITAR USML Category I; document classification rationale and license exception eligibility after the rule rescission.
For wireless-enabled accessories (optics, tracking devices), confirm intentional radiator approvals, modular FCC IDs, and supplier declarations before US entry.
Map each line to the 10-digit HTS code, check Section 301 lists and additional duty exposure, and document country of origin and value build-up on the commercial invoice.
Run restricted party screening against BIS Entity List, Denied Persons List, and OFAC SDN; retain end-user and end-use statements for controlled firearms and parts.

checklist.task: RoHS / REACH and WEEE check for accessories
checklist.desc: For electronic accessories, verify RoHS and REACH compliance and WEEE producer responsibility registration where EU-bound or transshipped.

checklist.task: Export license application or exception record
checklist.desc: If a license is required, file with BIS SNAP-R and keep the license exception record; if no license is required, retain a written determination for audit.
